ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a low global contrast ratio; high-intensity white pixels represent less than 10% of total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation with high-contrast white circular blobs clustered on the distal tips and scattered across the interior lobes. A single, prominent diagonal white linear feature is visible on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with steep interior pixel boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge, characterized by numerous discrete peaks and valleys of varying pixel depths.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex sweep from the central notch to the distal tips, terminating in jagged, non-linear edge profiles.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of numerous circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters localized heavily on the left and right distal lobe tips, with sparse distribution on the central lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible diagonal white linear disruption on the right lobe and several smaller, faint horizontal linear scratches near the midline of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips and significant traumatic serration/notching across the trailing edge boundary.
